[id 100]
First friend: 20 rings
Second friend: 20 + (1/4)*20 = 25 rings
Fourth friend: 60 rings
Third friend: 60 + 10 = 70 rings
Total rings = 20 + 25 + 70 + 60 = 175

[id 101]
Total pages to read = 4 + 20 + 7 + 8 = 39 pages
Pages left after Monday = 39 - 15 = 24 pages
Average per day for remaining 4 days = 24 / 4 = 6

[id 102]
Weekdays (5 days): 4 glasses/day (breakfast, lunch, dinner, bedtime) = 20 glasses
Weekends (2 days): 3 glasses/day (breakfast, lunch, soda) = 6 glasses
Total glasses per week = 20 + 6 = 26

[id 103]
Time to cover 3 miles = 10 minutes
Time to cover 42 miles = (42 / 3) * 10 = 14 * 10 = 140 minutes

[id 104]
Poppy places 1/4 of 1000 pieces = 250 pieces
Remaining pieces = 1000 - 250 = 750
Mom places 1/3 of remaining pieces = (1/3) * 750 = 250 pieces
Pieces left = 750 - 250 = 500

[id 105]
Amir eats 5 cookies
Cody eats 3 times as many as Amir = 3 * 5 = 15 cookies
Total cookies = 5 + 15 = 20

[id 106]
Inner dimensions of each box: (5-2)* (6-2) * (4-2) = 3 * 4 * 2 = 24 cubic inches
Total inner volume for 3 boxes = 3 * 24 = 72 cubic inches

[id 107]
Total TV time watched = 7 hours
Time accounted for:
- Monday: 1 hour
- Tuesday: 1 hour
- Thursday: 1 hour + 0.5 hours = 1.5 hours
- Friday: 2 hours
Total accounted for = 1 + 1 + 1.5 + 2 = 5.5 hours
Remaining time = 7 - 5.5 = 1.5 hours
Wednesday episodes = 1.5 hours / 0.5 hours per episode = 3 episodes

[id 108]
Let x be the number of cookies Henry baked last year.
Henry wanted to make 2x cookies this year.
He actually baked 2x + 15 cookies.
After dropping 5 cookies, he has 110 cookies.
Equation: 2x + 15 - 5 = 110
Simplify: 2x + 10 = 110
2x = 100
x = 50

[id 109]
Cost of 10 gallons of gas = 10 * $3.00 = $30.00
Cashback = 10 * $0.20 = $2.00
Total cost after cashback = $30.00 - $2.00 = $28.00
